title: The Refused Arrival Where Distance Learned to Say No

features.name: the closed gate at the field's end
features.desc-on-touch: Built to stay shut, riveted and certain. The paths all arrive here, and none pass through. Distance says no, and the gate agrees.

features.name: the gathered arrival-shoes
features.desc-on-touch: Boots and sandals left at the threshold, lined in rows. Each one walked here expecting entry. None of them moved past the gate.

features.name: the mile-marker that counts backward
features.desc-on-touch: As you approach the gate, distance increases. Three kilometres becomes four. The marker learns to refuse you before you refuse yourself.

features.name: the dust that stopped moving
features.desc-on-touch: Kicked up by a hundred journeys, now settling. The wind knows better than to carry it further. Even the smallest particles learned refusal here.

features.name: the sign that says nothing
features.desc-on-touch: No words, no warning, no explanation. Just a post where words could have been. Refusal needs no language.

inscription: arrivals and departures wear the same shoes; here is where the shoes stopped
